Amazon Detailed Interview Experience!
𝐂𝐨𝐦𝐩𝐞𝐧𝐬𝐚𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧: Base 19.5 LPA , 6.5 L Sign on Bonus Year-1 + 5.18 Sign on bonus Year-2, RSU 15.56 L (Vested in 4 years)
𝐏𝐨𝐬𝐢𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧: SDE1
𝐂𝐨𝐥𝐥𝐞𝐠𝐞: Not from well known (Can’t disclose the name)
𝐏𝐫𝐢𝐨𝐫 𝐞𝐱𝐩𝐞𝐫𝐢𝐞𝐧𝐜𝐞: 2 yrs 3 months (Worked in Service based company)
𝐀𝐩𝐩𝐥𝐢𝐞𝐝: HR directly reached out on LinkedIn

𝐑𝐨𝐮𝐧𝐝-𝟏 𝐎𝐧𝐥𝐢𝐧𝐞 𝐀𝐬𝐬𝐞𝐬𝐬𝐦𝐞𝐧𝐭
DSA Q-1 A medium-level problem based on strings and sorting.
DSA Q-2 A hard-level problem based on graphs.
Other: Multiple-choice questions based on Amazon Leadership Principles.
𝐏𝐞𝐫𝐟𝐨𝐫𝐦𝐚𝐧𝐜𝐞:Candidate solved all 2 dsa questions and received an interview call.

𝐑𝐨𝐮𝐧𝐝-𝟐 𝐃𝐒𝐀 + 𝐋𝐞𝐚𝐝𝐞𝐫𝐬𝐡𝐢𝐩 (𝐁𝐞𝐡𝐚𝐯𝐢𝐨𝐫𝐚𝐥)
DSA Q-1 Rotten Orange (BFS + Matrix, medium)
Ref: https://lnkd.in/g6RBg_th
DSA Q-2 Binary Tree Maximum Path Sum (Dp + Tree, Hard)
Ref: https://lnkd.in/g2xSPCJq
𝐏𝐞𝐫𝐟𝐨𝐫𝐦𝐚𝐧𝐜𝐞: Candidate could complete all two questions with optimal TC. 
𝐅𝐞𝐞𝐝𝐛𝐚𝐜𝐤 𝐑𝐞𝐜𝐞𝐢𝐯𝐞𝐝: Good on coding questions but mixed for the Amazon Leadership Principles.

𝐑𝐨𝐮𝐧𝐝-𝟑 𝐃𝐒𝐀 + 𝐋𝐞𝐚𝐝𝐞𝐫𝐬𝐡𝐢𝐩 (𝐁𝐞𝐡𝐚𝐯𝐢𝐨𝐫𝐚𝐥)
DSA Q-1 Walls and Gates (Grid Multi Source BFS, Medium)
Ref: https://lnkd.in/gKXJ978T
DSA Q-2 Group Anagrams (Hashing , Medium)
Ref: https://lnkd.in/gSZX3R2w 
Candidate was also asked 2-3 leadership questions. 
𝐏𝐞𝐫𝐟𝐨𝐫𝐦𝐚𝐧𝐜𝐞: Candidate could complete all two questions with optimal TC. 
𝐅𝐞𝐞𝐝𝐛𝐚𝐜𝐤 𝐑𝐞𝐜𝐞𝐢𝐯𝐞𝐝: Coding and Leadership both were positive this time.

𝐑𝐨𝐮𝐧𝐝-𝟒 𝐃𝐒𝐀 + 𝐋𝐞𝐚𝐝𝐞𝐫𝐬𝐡𝐢𝐩 (𝐁𝐞𝐡𝐚𝐯𝐢𝐨𝐫𝐚𝐥)
DSA Q-1 Maximum Profit in Job Scheduling (Binary Search + DP, Hard)
Ref: https://lnkd.in/gNXiinWG 
Candidate was asked 4-5 leadership questions.
𝐏𝐞𝐫𝐟𝐨𝐫𝐦𝐚𝐧𝐜𝐞: Completed DSA question in optimal TC and answered leadership questions using STAR method relating to his personal past experiences. 
𝐅𝐞𝐞𝐝𝐛𝐚𝐜𝐤 𝐑𝐞𝐜𝐞𝐢𝐯𝐞𝐝: Wait for the final results! Most impatient moments 😰😨

Candidate received an offer from Amazon 🥳🥳! 

𝐍𝐨𝐭𝐞: DSA questions were pretty standard but were of medium-hard leetcode level. Leadership principles are very important to get into Amazon, don't neglect this.

Stay tuned for more such detailed interview experiences🙌.

#InterviewExperience #Amazon #FAANG #SDE1
…see more

ai_analysis.summary: This post describes an Amazon SDE1 interview experience for a candidate with 2 years and 3 months of experience. The process included an online assessment, three DSA plus leadership rounds, and a final DSA plus leadership round. The DSA problems covered strings, sorting, graphs, matrix traversal, breadth-first search, trees, dynamic programming, hashing, grids, binary search, and job scheduling. The candidate used optimal time-complexity solutions and the STAR method for leadership questions, received an offer, and emphasizes the importance of Amazon Leadership Principles.

interview_questions.question: Which techniques does the post associate with the Rotten Orange and Walls and Gates problems?
interview_questions.answer:
Rotten Orange is associated with breadth-first search and matrix processing.
Walls and Gates is associated with grid traversal and multi-source breadth-first search.

interview_questions.question: Which data structures and algorithmic techniques were associated with Group Anagrams?
interview_questions.answer: The post identifies hashing as the technique used for Group Anagrams.

interview_questions.question: Which techniques were used for Maximum Profit in Job Scheduling?
interview_questions.answer:
The post associates the problem with binary search and dynamic programming.
The candidate was expected to complete the problem with optimal time complexity.

interview_questions.question: What computational topics appeared in the Amazon SDE1 DSA rounds?
interview_questions.answer:
The questions covered strings, sorting, graphs, matrices, breadth-first search, trees, dynamic programming, hashing, grids, binary search, and job scheduling.
The post characterizes the DSA questions as standard but at medium to hard difficulty.

interview_questions.question: How did Amazon Leadership Principles affect the interview process described in the post?
interview_questions.answer:
Leadership Principles were included in the online assessment and in leadership questions during multiple rounds.
The post states that strong performance on both coding and leadership was important.

interview_questions.question: How should a candidate structure responses to the leadership questions described in the post?
interview_questions.answer:
A strong answer uses the STAR method.
The response should connect the answer to a personal past experience.
